Before buying a second-hand watch, ensure your watch's reference number matches with your watch, and secondly ensure your movement has been used by the manufacturer for your reference number. These two checks are not enough but are the main points of a verification..

At Mainspring, we make all the required and detailed inspections before we buy a watch to display in our store and present to our customers. 
We issue a store authenticity liability certificate with each watch we sell and also provide 3 months warranty.

A true icon of Swiss watchmaking. 🇨🇭⌚

Jaeger-LeCoultre Polaris Automatic — where timeless elegance meets sporty sophistication.

For the first time, the lacquered face of the Polaris Date watch sports a green that is as deep as it is subtle. Depending on the play of light, the color evolves and transforms from a contrasting dark green to a soft, luminous hue. With its innovative décor, the Super-LumiNova® hour markers and numerals stand out in all their brilliance alongside the skeletonized hands with luminescent tips. 
The sharp lined, 42-mm stainless steel case boasts a double-polished satin finish and is complemented by an easily interchangeable green rubber strap with a Clous de Paris motif. 
The sapphire crystal case back reveals the finishes of the new generation Jaeger-LeCoultre Calibre 899. 
Designed, produced and assembled under the same roof, this Manufacture movement offers a 70-hour power reserve, a highly practical feature for a sports watch.

✨ Details:
• Reference: Q906863J
• Year: 2022
• Automatic Calibre 899 JLC in-house movement
• 42mm Stainless steel case
• Green & black graded dial with luminous markers
• Original rubber strap
• Like-new condition
• Full set with box & papers

💰 Price: AED 33,000
